CITY OF LA VERNE
  Adjourned Meeting

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

 Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
 Muir Davis, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
 Robin Carder, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
 Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
 Wendy M. Lau, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Monday, October 4, 2021, 6:00 p.m.
  La Verne City Hall - Council Chambers,
  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a modification
or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909)
596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Monday of
every month.

The Council Chambers will be opened to the public. In an effort to keep a safe environment and to minimize
the spread of the COVID-19 Virus, the City will be limiting occupancy to invited guests only and masking will
be required for all in attendance. To facilitate public participation for those who do not wish to attend in
person, the meeting will still be made available virtually to residents. Provisions will be made for public viewing
with a sound system outside of the Council Chambers. Below are the following opportunities on how to
participate:

  1)  View the meeting through the City’s website at www.cityoflaverne.org and click on the green “Council
  Meeting Live Stream” button.

  2)  Individuals can email their comments to the Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org up
  to noon on the day of the meeting. Those comments will be shared with City Council in advance
  of the City Council meeting and included as part of the permanent record. Please be advised
  that public comments submitted by emails or any other format to the City are public
  records that will be made available for public viewing.

  3)  Individuals who wish to share their comments directly during the meeting may do so by emailing the
  Assistant City Clerk at cityclerk@cityoflaverne.org with their phone number and the item(s) they wish
  to speak on. Requests will be accepted before and throughout the meeting and staff will call you
  back at the appropriate time. Once items are considered by the City Council, no further public
  comment on that matter will be accepted. A time limit of 3-minutes is set for all public comments.

  4)  If you wish to participate via Zoom, you will need to register at
  https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_GKlF7zPwSAOhT2Lb9NX05A
  before 12:00 p.m. on Monday, October 4, 2021, and please be aware that space is limited. You will
  have the ability to watch the meeting in real time and raise your hand to request to comment as
  appropriate on the current agenda item(s). Once it is your turn to speak, you will be brought into the
  meeting and have the ability to turn your video on when called upon.
 Agenda, Adjourned Meeting, Monday, October 4, 2021, page 2.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER

  2.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Carder,
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis and Mayor Hepburn.

  3.  Badge Pinning Ceremony for Newly Hired Police Officers, as follows:

  Jullian Silva - Jullian was born and raised in San Bernardino, California and is the oldest of two
  children. In 2012, Jullian graduated from Cajon High school with high honors, and went on to enlist in
  the United States Marine Corps. In the summer of 2012, he began his service as a communications
  technician with the Marines. Over the next six years, he rose to the rank of Corporal while
  simultaneously attending college classes at California State University of San Bernardino. In 2018,
  Jullian graduated with his Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice. Shortly after obtaining his degree,
  Jullian chose to separate from the Marine Corps and began working for the City of Colton Streets
  Department. During his time with the City of Colton, he supervised the departments Work Release
  Program, supervising out of custody inmates. In February of 2020, Jullian accepted the opportunity to
  pursue a career as a Police Officer with the City of La Verne. He attended Rio Hondo Police Academy,
  where he was faced with many challenges especially during the global pandemic. He graduated as
  President of Rio Hondo Police Academy Class 210 in November of 2020. His mother will be pining his
  badge.

  Eduardo Burgos - Eduardo grew up in the City of Ontario where he attended Chaffey High School and
  played both football and basketball. He was a police explorer with the Ontario Police Department.
  Eduardo’s dream of working as a sworn law enforcement officer became a reality on August 22, 2019,
  when he began his career with the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department. After working as a
  custody deputy for two years, he was hired to work as a police officer to serve and protect the
  community of La Verne. Eduardo is happy and excited to be working for the City of La Verme Police
  Department and he is thankful to everyone who has supported him throughout his journey as well as
  the City of La Verne, for giving him the opportunity to serve and protect its residents. Eduardo is a
  father of two children. On his off time, he enjoys spending time with his family and coaching his son’s
  football team. His Fiancé will be pinning his badge.

  Daniel Salamanca - Daniel Salamanca was born in Whittier in 1993. He attended school in the
  th
  Claremont School District from elementary through high school. When Daniel was in 6 grade, two
  police officers spoke during career day and that was the day he decided he wanted to be a police
  officer. After graduating from Claremont High School he attended Mount San Antonio College where
  he completed his Associate’s Degree in Administration of Justice. Daniel graduated from the University
  of La Verne with a Bachelor’s degree in Communications in 2020. He had a high regard for the City of
  La Verne, since visiting with his sister back in 2004, when she attended the University of La Verne.
  Daniel recognized the great opportunity to achieve his career goals of becoming a law enforcement
  officer when he heard that the City of La Verne was hiring for a police officer. He was hired by the
  La Verne Police Department in 2021, and attended Rio Hondo Police Academy graduating on August
  11, 2021. Daniel looks forward to having a long career with the La Verne Police Department and to
  honorably serve and represent the City. His sister will be pining his badge.
 Agenda, Adjourned Meeting, Monday, October 4, 2021, page 3

  Allison Geller - Allison was born in West Covina in 1996. She grew up in San Dimas and spent most
  of her grade school years in La Verne. At the age of 7, Allison was blessed to be adopted into a family
  that cared about giving back to the community. Through their compassion and love for others, it
  showed her the true meaning of helping people and giving back to others. Every step she has taken in
  her life has led her to becoming a police officer, through work experience, life experience, and
  education. Allison graduated from Cal State LA with a Bachelor’s Degree in Criminal Justice and a
  Minor in Biology. Allison has had multiple jobs in her life, all of which involved customer service. She
  began her career in law enforcement at La Verne Police Department two years ago as a Police Cadet.
  As she finished up with college in 2020, there was no better a time to apply for the Police Officer
  position with La Verne. Allison feels fortunate and very excited to be officially starting her career as a
  police officer with the La Verne Police Department. Her mother will be pinning her badge.

  4.  The La Verne City Council will recess to the La Verne City Council Meeting at 6:30 p.m.

  ADVISORY STAFF

  Robert Russi, City Manager
  JR Ranells, Assistant to the City Manager
  Robert Kress, City Attorney
  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, Assistant City Clerk
  Shawn Igoe, Public Works Director
  Eric Scherer, Community Development Director
  Marla Pendleton, Finance Director
  Nick Paz, Police Chief
  ____Christopher Nigg, Fire Chief
  Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager
  Cody Howing, City Engineer

  Posting Statement: On September 28, 2021, a true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on the bulletin
  board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at cityoflaverne.org.
